articles.title: Cubs star Alex Bregman hospitalized after taking brutal foul ball to the face
articles.standfirst: The third baseman was sent for hospital tests after being hit near the eye during Chicago’s win over Cincinnati
articles.summary: The third baseman was sent for hospital tests after being hit near the eye during Chicago’s win over Cincinnati
articles.body:
A routine moment near the on-deck circle turned frightening for Alex Bregman on Sunday when a foul ball struck the Chicago Cubs third baseman directly in the face, leaving his left eye badly swollen and forcing him out of the game.

Bregman was standing several feet in front of the on-deck circle during Chicago’s 9-1 win over the Cincinnati Reds when teammate Michael Busch checked his swing and deflected the ball sharply toward him. The ball hit Bregman around the left eye.

He immediately dropped his bat and staggered backward while clutching his face, then made his way toward the Cubs dugout as trainers rushed to assist him.

Bregman was eventually taken to a Cincinnati-area hospital for X-rays and a CT scan. No official timetable for his return had been announced.

Bregman shares graphic photos

Bregman later gave fans a glimpse of the damage himself. He posted a photo on Instagram showing his left eye swollen shut, bruising around the area and dried blood near his nose.

“Thanks for all the messages yall,” Bregman wrote. “I’ll be back.”

Because of the medical testing in Cincinnati, Bregman didn't immediately travel home with the rest of the Cubs . He later posted another image after returning to Chicago, simply writing: “Back in Chicago.”

The swelling around his eye appeared even more pronounced in the second photo. The Cubs hadn't provided a detailed medical update on the extent of the injury, making it unclear whether Bregman will be available when Chicago opens its next series against the Miami Marlins .

Injury comes at crucial moment in Cubs’ playoff push

Any absence would be significant with the regular season nearly over.

Chicago entered the final week needing only one win or one Arizona Diamondbacks loss to secure a postseason berth, but playoff seeding remains unsettled.

The Cubs are battling near the top of the National League wild-card standings, with the San Diego Padres and Philadelphia Phillies also in the mix.

Bregman has become one of Chicago’s most important hitters after an uneven start to his first season with the club.

The 32-year-old signed a five-year, $175 million contract with the Cubs after spending 2025 with the Boston Red Sox . He has 26 home runs this season with a .262 batting average and .352 on-base percentage.

His production has surged dramatically in the second half. Bregman has posted an OPS around 1.000 over his last two months, while also providing elite defense at third base.

His postseason experience could matter even more once October begins. A two-time World Series champion, Bregman ranks among baseball’s most experienced active playoff performers.

Chicago now has to wait for the medical picture to become clearer. Bregman ’s message made his intentions obvious.

articles.title: Alex Bregman’s brutal injury could force MLB to break longstanding tradition: “We don’t have to be doing that forever”
articles.standfirst: Bregman was the victim of a truly unfortunate situation that’s rarely seen in baseball.
articles.summary: Bregman was the victim of a truly unfortunate situation that’s rarely seen in baseball.
articles.body:
Right now, the Chicago Cubs need all hands on deck for the final regular season stretch. The division crown is out of sight, and the top spot in the NL Wild Card race is up for grabs. Unfortunately, the team lost one of its best players for the home stretch this past weekend.

Alex Bregman suffered a brutal injury, and it came in the most unfortunate of ways. While standing in the on-deck circle, Bregman was struck in the face by a foul ball from his Cubs teammate . Bregman suffered multiple facial fractures , and his photo after it happened was jaw-dropping.

Bregman’s injury has had many fans wondering a couple of things. Firstly, many are surprised that this type of thing doesn’t happen more often . The margin for error while on-deck hitters stand so close to the batter’s box is very small. We’ve seen similar situations before, but it’s somewhat surprising it’s not more prevalent.

Trevor Plouffe calls for MLB to protect on-deck hitters going forward

But even though it doesn’t happen as often as one might assume, even former MLB players like Trevor Plouffe believe it’s time for baseball to make a change to avoid this type of injury in the future. Plouffe made his plea on the “ Talkin’ Baseball ” podcast on Monday.

It takes something like this to happen. Like, if this were in the playoffs and all of a sudden Alex Bregman can’t play anymore in the playoffs, it shocks people into action. Like, maybe this is close enough to it. How about we put a screen net or something?

There’s simply no reason to have a player be that close when he’s not actively hitting. Sure, being that close allows the on-deck hitter to get a better feel for the pitcher on the mound, but they can do that from the dugout, or with more protection around him.
